newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: GOLF-MADEIRA TOURNAMENT CUT TO 54 HOLES.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MADEIRA TOURNAMENT CUT TO 54 HOLES.

text.p: The Madeira Island Open was cut on Friday from 72 holes to 54 after much of the opening day on Thursday was lost to near gale-force winds and mist.
When all the field had completed one round on Friday, Scotland's Andrew Coltart led by one stroke, having shot a six-under-par 66.
Dutchman Rolf Muntz had a 67, one shot ahead of Briton Ross McFarlane, Sweden's Fredrik Jacobson and Spaniard Ignacio Garrido.
